comments.author: @Grayzii_400
comments.text:
My aunt and I still say Sneaky Pete could have gone on for several more seasons. We absolutely hated to see it end! The whole concept had so much room to grow because Marius could have walked into a completely new situation every season—another family, another group of people who had been conned or were in trouble, and somehow he gets pulled into it. Then, when things get too deep, he has to call up the old crew and work his magic again.

And that's really what made Sneaky Pete so much fun to watch. Marius didn't have actual magic—his "magic" was his ability to read people, think on his feet, talk his way through impossible situations, and somehow pull off a con when you thought there was NO way out.

I've loved watching Giovanni Ribisi since I was a little girl in the late '90s, and this is still one of my favorite roles of his. He was absolutely made for Marius. I really wish somebody would bring Sneaky Pete back for at least one more season. There were so many more stories that could have been told. My aunt and I would be watching on DAY ONE. 😂❤️
